title: Create HubSpot contacts with AI from plain notes
h1: turn a contact note into a new hubspot contact
description: Create a HubSpot contact from a plain-language note with an AI bot. Check the mapped fields, avoid duplicate entries and plan for the required OpenAI API key.
keywords: hubspot contact from notes with ai
answer: a bot can create a hubspot contact from a note containing the person's name, email and other details you know. this action uses the contact fields in your hubspot setup to turn the note into a new record. it requires an openai api key as well as hubspot access. creating the record is a change, so it does not automatically ask for sending approval.
og_line: a contact record from details you know.
what:
write the contact details as you would explain them to a colleague. the action reads hubspot's contact field definitions and uses an ai step to decide which values belong in which fields. check that mapping before letting an incomplete note become a customer record.

company or deal links are optional, separate choices; the action does not generate those links from the note. if you request one, the bot must find the existing record first. this action's openai api key requirement is separate from choosing the ai that your dusk bot uses.
uses: save a new business contact from the details they gave you at an event
turn a confirmed referral note into a contact with the known name and email
enter a person from a signed-off account brief without guessing their role or phone
create a new contact and link it to the specific existing deal you have named

routine.message: every tuesday at 5, review new contact notes i marked ready in this chat since the previous run. search hubspot for each email first and bring me any possible existing match instead of creating another contact. for a new person, show the proposed fields here and ask me before creating the record from my note, then report what was saved. never guess missing details, create company links or continue if the required openai api key is unavailable.
routine.needs: hubspot connected, with read and write access for this bot; this action also requires an openai api key
routine.output:
created after your field review

marisol vega
email: marisol@example.com
company text: rainquill design
phone: left blank

no company or deal link added.

steps: connect hubspot through **Connected apps** and allow **read and write** for the contact-entry bot.
check that this particular action's openai api key requirement can be met before relying on it; signing the bot into an ai app alone is not enough.
try a single contact note, asking the bot to search for an existing email match and show the proposed fields before creating anything.
keep 'ask me before creating the record' in the routine and use **Pause** if the first saved contact maps a detail incorrectly.
watch: an openai api key is required for this action even when the dusk bot thinks with another ai. if the key is unavailable, the bot should stop rather than promise creation.
this creates a contact; it does not promise to detect duplicates or update an existing person. the routine's separate contact search matters.
an ai step chooses field values from your description. vague job titles or incomplete notes can be mapped incorrectly.
contact creation uses write access and is outside the sending setting. review happens here because the routine explicitly asks for it.

faq.q: do i need an openai api key if my bot uses claude?
faq.a: yes, for this contact-creation action. its internal ai step requires that key independently of the ai you chose for the bot.

faq.q: does mentioning a company link the contact to it?
faq.a: do not assume so. a company name in the note and a link to an existing company record are separate things; the latter needs an explicit association after the bot finds the intended company.

faq.q: will it fill in a missing phone number?
faq.a: the note should contain only details you know. tell the bot to leave missing information blank and bring uncertain fields back for your review.
